newsitem.title: USA: World air cargo up 4.8 pct in Jan-Jun 96 says ACI.
newsitem.headline: World air cargo up 4.8 pct in Jan-Jun 96 says ACI.

text.p: Freight and mail traffic handled by 458 airports around the world between January and June 1996, totalled 23.28 million tonnes, up 4.8 percent on the same period the previous year, said Geneva-based Airports Council International (ACI).
North America, the biggest of ACI's six cargo-handling regions, reported 12.49 million tonnes of freight traffic, up 5.5 percent on January-June 1995.
January-June 1996 handled at ACI's Europe member airports totalled 4.87 million tonnes, a rise of 3.8 percent on the same period in 1995.
Airports in the Asia/Pacific region (in which ACI incorporates Indo-China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Thailand, Japan, Malaysia and Australia), had a cargo throughput of 4.45 million tonnes, up four percent.
Middle East airports recorded the highest growth rate of ACI's cargo-handling regions in the period in question, throughput rising 18.4 percent to 778,951 tonnes.
By contrast, at Latin America/Caribbean airports, January-June 1996 freight traffic handled was down 9.8 percent on 1995 levels at 505,399 tonnes.
African airports cargo traffic declined by 1.1 percent on the first six months of 1995 to 189,544 tonnes. - Air Cargo Newsroom tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
